body: Commit 52bf4b8 (+ CHANGELOG). Installed gymnasium+stable-baselines3 (pip --break-system-packages, no clean alternative available) and ran the full pipeline for real: a 4000-timestep PPO smoke run trained cleanly (SubprocVecEnv, real checkpointing, real eval), closing every previously-flagged 'not independently verified' gap in S170-225/226/227. Exporting the real trained model surfaced a genuine bug: write_c_header_from_layers produced invalid C literals (0f instead of 0.0f) for exact-integer weights, never hit by the earlier synthetic random-weight test. Fixed + re-verified end to end against the real model (PyTorch vs compiled C match to float32 precision) + added a --self-test regression check.
title: S170-227 follow-up: ran the real RL pipeline live, fixed an export bug it surfaced
